## Loading packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
y <- read.csv("/simdata/ar_sim.csv")

## Compile models
mod_ar   <- cmdstan_model("models/ar.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))
mod_arr2 <- cmdstan_model("models/arr2.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))

## Stationary check
r2_from_phi <- function(phi) {
  if (any(!is.finite(phi))) return(NA_real_)
  if (any(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -phi))) <= 1)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(phi * ARMAacf(ar = phi, lag.max = length(phi))[-1])
}

## Generate Dirichlet parameters for Minnesota variant
minnesota_cons <- function(p) (p^2 / 10) * (1 / (1:p)^2)

## Configs
p_grid  <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24)
mean_R2_1 <- 1/3
prec_R2_1 <- 3
mean_R2_2 <- 2/3
prec_R2_2 <- 9

configs <- list(
  list(label = "naive (sd = 1)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 1.0)),
  list(label = "naive (sd = 0.5)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 0.5)),
  list(label = "ARR2 flat (R2 mean = 1/3)", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = rep(1, p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_1, prec_R2 = prec_R2_1)),
    list(label = "ARR2 flat (R2 mean = 2/3)", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = rep(1, p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_2, prec_R2 = prec_R2_2)),
  list(label = "ARR2 Minn. (R2 mean = 1/3)", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_1, prec_R2 = prec_R2_1)),
  list(label = "ARR2 Minn. (R2 mean = 2/3)", model = mod_arr2,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_2, prec_R2 = prec_R2_2))
)

## Running sweep
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
 
draws_list <- list()
 
results_1 <- map_dfr(p_grid, function(p) {
  map_dfr(configs, function(cfg) {
 
    stan_data <- c(
      list(T = length(Y), Y = Y, p = p,
           sigma_sd = 1, prior_only = 1L),
      cfg$data(p)
    )
 
    fit <- cfg$model$sample(
      data            = stan_data,
      chains          = 4,
      iter_warmup     = 1000,
      iter_sampling   = 1000,
      refresh         = 0,
      show_messages   = FALSE,
      show_exceptions = FALSE
    )
 
    phi_draws <- fit$draws("phi", format = "draws_matrix")
 
    r2_exact <- apply(phi_draws, 1, r2_from_phi)
    stat     <- !is.na(r2_exact)
    r2_cens  <- ifelse(stat, r2_exact, 1)
 
    r2_knob <- if ("R2" %in% fit$metadata()$stan_variables) {
      as.numeric(fit$draws("R2", format = "draws_matrix"))
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, length(stat))
    }
 
    diag <- fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
 
    draws_list[[paste(cfg$label, p)]] <<- tibble(
      config = cfg$label, p = p, draw = seq_along(stat),
      stationary = stat, r2_exact = r2_exact,
      r2_cens = r2_cens, r2_knob = r2_knob
    )
 
    tibble(
      config      = cfg$label,
      p           = p,
      n_draws     = length(stat),
      prop_stat   = mean(stat),
      mcse        = sqrt(prop_stat * (1 - prop_stat) / n_draws),
      r2_med = if (any(stat)) median(r2_exact[stat]) else NA_real_,
      r2_q05      = if (any(stat)) unname(quantile(r2_exact[stat], 0.05)),
      r2_q95      = if (any(stat)) unname(quantile(r2_exact[stat], 0.95)),
      knob_med    = median(r2_knob, na.rm = TRUE),
      divergences = sum(diag$num_divergent),
      max_rhat    = max(fit$summary("phi")$rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
})

all_draws <- bind_rows(draws_list)

print(results_1 %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))), n = Inf)

write_csv(results_1,   "results/prior_r2_consistency_1.csv")
write_csv(all_draws_1, "results/prior_r2_draws_1.csv")
```

```{r}
p_r2_1 <- results_1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, r2_stat_med, colour = config)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = r2_q05, ymax = r2_q95), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p",
       y = expression("Prior-implied " * R^2 * " (among stationary coefficient vector)"),
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Prior-implied R-squared by lag order",
       subtitle = "Median and 90% band") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
p_stat_1 <- results_1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, prop_stat, colour = config)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = prop_stat - 2 * mcse,
                      ymax = prop_stat + 2 * mcse)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = "Proportion of prior draws stationary",
       colour = NULL, title = "Stationary prior mass by lag order") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
p_r2_1
p_stat_1
```

```{r}
ggsave("figures/prior_r2_by_p_1.png",    p_r2_1,   width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave("figures/prior_stationarity_1.png", p_stat_1, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
```

### Fixed-sigma version

```{r}
## Compile models
mod_ar <- cmdstan_model("models/ar.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))
mod_arr2_prior <- cmdstan_model("models/arr2-prior.stan",
                          stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE))

## Stationary check
r2_from_phi <- function(phi) {
  if (any(!is.finite(phi))) return(NA_real_)
  if (any(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -phi))) <= 1)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(phi * ARMAacf(ar = phi, lag.max = length(phi))[-1])
}

## Generate Dirichlet parameters for Minnesota variant
minnesota_cons <- function(p) (p^2 / 10) * (1 / (1:p)^2)

## Configs
p_grid  <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24)
mean_R2_1 <- 1/3
prec_R2_1 <- 3
mean_R2_2 <- 2/3
prec_R2_2 <- 9

configs <- list(
  list(label = "naive (sd = 1)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 1.0)),
  list(label = "naive (sd = 0.5)", model = mod_ar,
       data = function(p) list(phi_sd = 0.5)),
  list(label = "ARR2 flat (R2 mean = 1/3)", model = mod_arr2_prior,
       data = function(p) list(cons = rep(1, p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_1, prec_R2 = prec_R2_1)),
    list(label = "ARR2 flat (R2 mean = 2/3)", model = mod_arr2_prior,
       data = function(p) list(cons = rep(1, p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_2, prec_R2 = prec_R2_2)),
  list(label = "ARR2 Minn. (R2 mean = 1/3)", model = mod_arr2_prior,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_1, prec_R2 = prec_R2_1)),
  list(label = "ARR2 Minn. (R2 mean = 2/3)", model = mod_arr2_prior,
       data = function(p) list(cons = minnesota_cons(p),
                               mean_R2 = mean_R2_2, prec_R2 = prec_R2_2))
)
 
draws_list <- list()
 
results_2 <- map_dfr(p_grid, function(p) {
  map_dfr(configs, function(cfg) {
 
    stan_data <- c(
      list(T = length(Y), Y = Y, 
           p = p, prior_only = 1L),
      cfg$data(p)
    )
 
    fit <- cfg$model$sample(
      data            = stan_data,
      chains          = 4,
      iter_warmup     = 1000,
      iter_sampling   = 1000,
      refresh         = 0,
      show_messages   = FALSE,
      show_exceptions = FALSE
    )
 
    phi_draws <- fit$draws("phi", format = "draws_matrix")
 
    r2_exact <- apply(phi_draws, 1, r2_from_phi)
    stat     <- !is.na(r2_exact)
    r2_cens  <- ifelse(stat, r2_exact, 1)
 
    r2_knob <- if ("R2" %in% fit$metadata()$stan_variables) {
      as.numeric(fit$draws("R2", format = "draws_matrix"))
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, length(stat))
    }
 
    diag <- fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
 
    draws_list[[paste(cfg$label, p)]] <<- tibble(
      config = cfg$label, p = p, draw = seq_along(stat),
      stationary = stat, r2_exact = r2_exact,
      r2_cens = r2_cens, r2_knob = r2_knob
    )
 
    tibble(
      config      = cfg$label,
      p           = p,
      n_draws     = length(stat),
      prop_stat   = mean(stat),
      mcse        = sqrt(prop_stat * (1 - prop_stat) / n_draws),
      r2_med = if (any(stat)) median(r2_exact[stat]) else NA_real_,
      r2_q05      = if (any(stat)) unname(quantile(r2_exact[stat], 0.05)),
      r2_q95      = if (any(stat)) unname(quantile(r2_exact[stat], 0.95)),
      knob_med    = median(r2_knob, na.rm = TRUE),
      divergences = sum(diag$num_divergent),
      max_rhat    = max(fit$summary("phi")$rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
})

all_draws <- bind_rows(draws_list)

print(results_2 %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))), n = Inf)

write_csv(results_2,   "results/prior_r2_consistency_2.csv")
write_csv(all_draws_2, "results/prior_r2_draws_2.csv")
```
